chunks: Muḥammad ibn Sinān narrated from al-ʿAlāʾ ibn al-Fuḍayl, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
“Then contract mukātabah with them if you know good in them.”
He عليه السلام said: “If you know that they have wealth.”
He said: I said, “And give them from the wealth of Allah which He has given you.”
He عليه السلام said: “You reduce for him from his installments that which you had not been intending to reduce from them at all, and you do not increase it beyond what was in your mind.”
So I said: “How much?” He عليه السلام said: “Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام reduced one thousand from six thousand for a slave belonging to him.”

key_terms.خَيْرًا: Good here interpreted as financial means or wealth
key_terms.فَكَاتِبُوهُمْ: Contract mukātabah with them, meaning a manumission agreement
key_terms.مَالًا: Wealth or property possessed by the slave
key_terms.مِنْ مَالِ اللَّهِ: From the wealth of Allah, i.e. what Allah has granted you
key_terms.نُجُومِهِ: His installments or scheduled payments in the mukātabah contract
key_terms.وَ آتُوهُمْ: Give them, meaning provide a financial concession

ai.seo_question: What does Qur'an 24:33 mean by writing a contract for slaves and giving them from Allah’s wealth?
ai.summary: This hadith explains two phrases from Qur'an 24:33 in the context of mukātabah, the contract of manumission. It interprets “good” as the slave possessing wealth, and explains giving from Allah’s wealth as reducing part of the agreed installments, with an example from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام remitting one thousand out of six thousand.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.3469 - Muhammad ibn Sinan narrated from al-Ala' ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding the saying of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic: "Then write [a contract of emancipation] for them if you know any good in them" (Surah An-Nur 24:33).
Imam (as) said: "If you know that they possess wealth."
I asked about the verse: 'And give them from the wealth of Allah which He has given you,' (Surah An-Nur 24:33).
Imam (as) said: "You reduce for them from their installments what you did not initially intend to reduce, and do not increase it beyond what you originally intended."
I asked: "How much?"
Imam (as) said: "Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), reduced one thousand out of six thousand for one of his slaves."
